steps.label: Region
steps.sub: a geographic area, e.g. us-east-1, eastus

steps.label: Availability Zone
steps.sub: one isolated datacenter inside that region

code:
Load balancer
  -> Web server in us-east-1a   (power outage hits this datacenter)
  -> Web server in us-east-1b   (healthy — takes over automatically)

Result: customers never notice the outage in 1a.
caption: Two servers, two AZs, one load balancer — one facility's failure doesn't take the site down.

steps.label: Multi-region
steps.sub: bigger step — disaster recovery and global latency
